A puzzle of weight & consequence

The lab went quiet.
The scales didn’t.

An endless puzzle for iPhone. Drop numbered balls into eight columns that stand on four scales. Every ball shifts the weight — and every shift changes the board. Easy to start. Hard to keep in balance.

How it plays

Nothing stays
in balance for long.

Every ball has a mass. Columns stand in pairs on four scales, and the heavier side sinks. Line up three or more of one colour in a row and they dissolve. Stack five of a colour in a column and they fuse into one heavy ball. Let a stack cross the carriage line, and the experiment is over. Balance is the whole game.

Special balls

Twenty ways
to break the rules.

From level 3, a new special ball opens every level, all twenty by level 18. The strongest, the triangle flash, comes last. Each one changes the board in its own way.

  • Silver starEvery level

    Three silver stars in a row clear the whole field, without points. A joker can stand in for a star. A silver star landing on another makes a gold star.

  • Gold starTwo silver stars

    Three gold stars in a row clear the whole field and score all its balls; the multiplier jumps to ×4. A joker can stand in for a star.

  • HeartThrown over the edge

    A ball thrown over the edge comes back as a heart. Hearts match each other like a colour, and a group with hearts scores a bonus. Weighs nothing.

  • JokerFrom level 3

    Fits any colour, a star or a heart, so it can complete a line of three. It also joins a waiting group it touches. Weighs nothing; lines with it score as usual.

  • MysteryFrom level 3

    Blank in the reserve. In the carriage it turns into a random ball: half the time a regular one, otherwise one of the specials already unlocked.

  • BombFrom level 4

    Explodes on landing and removes every ball in the 3×3 square around it. No points for removed balls.

  • CutterFrom level 5

    Removes its whole column, itself included, and the scales rebalance. No points for removed balls.

  • Colour zapFrom level 6

    Removes every ball on the field of the colour it lands on. No points.

  • TintFrom level 7

    Repaints its whole column in the colour it lands on. Masses stay the same, and new lines of three score as usual.

  • FlashFrom level 8

    In the widening triangle below it, repaints up to two random balls of other colours in each row in the colour it lands on.

  • Colour jokerFrom level 9

    Turns every ball of the colour it lands on into a joker. Jokers weigh nothing, so the scales may tip.

  • Diagonal zapFrom level 10

    Removes every ball on both diagonals through the spot where it lands. No points.

  • Top zapFrom level 11

    Removes the top ball of every column. No points.

  • Bottom tintFrom level 12

    Repaints the bottom ball of every column in the colour it lands on.

  • Diagonal flashFrom level 13

    Repaints the balls on both diagonals running down from it in the colour it lands on.

  • Colour bombFrom level 14

    Every ball of the colour it lands on explodes, removing the 3×3 square around each. No points.

  • Horizontal zapFrom level 15

    Removes the whole row of the ball it lands on. No points.

  • Multicolour zapFrom level 16

    Takes every colour in its column below it and removes all balls of those colours from the field. No points.

  • Tint 3×3From level 17

    Repaints the 3×3 square around it in the colour it lands on.

  • Triangle flashFrom level 18

    Repaints the whole widening triangle below it in the colour it lands on.

  • Every special ball weighs nothing.
  • “The colour it lands on” is the colour of the ball right under it. On an empty pan, or on a ball with no colour, nothing is repainted.
  • Balls removed outright by a special score no points. Lines completed with jokers or hearts score as usual, hearts add a bonus, and gold stars score the whole field.
  • Some special balls are gifts along the way. Extra packs are optional in-app purchases.
